author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Learn how to connect Claude to Blender and create 3D models and animations using everyday language. In this step-by-step tutorial, we'll install the Blender connector and MCP add-on, build a colorful 3D cookie shop, add objects, change the lighting and textures, animate the camera and a rotating cookie, and render the result as a 1080p MP4 video.

Host: Kevin Stratvert

📚 RESOURCES
- Download Blender: https://www.blender.org/download/
- Download Claude Desktop: https://claude.com/download
- Official Blender MCP Server and add-on: https://www.blender.org/lab/mcp-server/

⌚ TIMESTAMPS
0:00 - Introduction
0:18 - Get Blender and Claude Desktop
0:39 - Install the Blender connector in Claude
1:01 - Install the Blender MCP add-on
2:03 - Create a 3D cookie shop with Claude
3:07 - Add tables, chairs, and flowers
3:38 - Change lighting, textures, and the sign
4:06 - Animate the camera and cookie
4:47 - Render and export an MP4 video
5:16 - Finished animation and next steps
